sentences.text: Kaakha Kaakha -LRB- To Protect -RRB- is a 2003 Tamil-language action drama film written and directed by Gautham Menon .	Tamil-language	Tamil language	action drama	action drama	Gautham Menon	Gautham Menon

Starring Suriya , Jyothika and Jeevan , the film featured music composed by Harris Jayaraj and cinematography by R. D. Rajasekhar .	Suriya	Suriya (actor)	Jyothika	Jyothika	Jeevan	Jeevan (Tamil actor)	Harris Jayaraj	Harris Jayaraj	R. D. Rajasekhar	R. D. Rajasekhar

The film released to highly positive reviews in August 2003 and went on to become the first biggest blockbuster in Suriya 's career , and was considered a comeback film for producer Kalaipuli S. Thanu .	Kalaipuli S. Thanu	Kalaipuli S. Thanu	Suriya	Suriya (actor)
Owing to the success , the film has been remade in several languages .
